protocol.scope: prediction must overlap an annotated table or negative region

denominators.detection_precision: TP + in-scope FP (predictions on annotated pages)
denominators.cell_text: matched tables; multiset F1 over non-empty cell texts
denominators.header_cell_text: 1 matched tables with equal column count; multiset F1 over non-empty header labels, whitespace-free
denominators.header_column_attribution: 5 labelled gold header columns (empty gold labels excluded) in 1 comparable matched tables; strict variant keeps intra-label spacing
denominators.header_row_detection: header_rows exact over all matched tables
denominators.column_role: 5 gold columns in comparable matched tables
